code_metrics.definition: Pooled count of satisfied requested category-relation-category triples / pooled number of requested triples across scenes. Predicted relations generated from object geometry; duplicate requested triples consume generated matching triples one at a time. Easy variant relaxes closely relation.
code_metrics.denominator: Requested instruction triples, not object count or all possible/reference relations

code_metrics.definition: cleanfid feature-distribution comparison of generated topdown PNGs versus held-out real rendered scene PNGs; CLIP-FID uses clip_vit_b_32; displayed KID multiplied by 1000.
code_metrics.denominator: Distribution of generated/reference rendered images; cannot infer per-room validity

code_metrics.definition: For each requested description, best same-category generated asset CLIP cosine(image,description) minus cosine(image,class). DOS clamps >=0, missing=0; DOS_fixed missing=-2; DOS_recall uses unclamped score with missing=0. Aggregates requested descriptions then scenes.
code_metrics.denominator: Requested descriptions / evaluated scenes; missing behavior differs by variant

code_metrics.definition: inter_vol from half-extent footprints and vertical intervals. Current iomin normalizer is sx*sy*sz, then mean over whole M*M matrix after zeroing diagonal. Current vol_mean averages whole M*M; vol_sum sums ordered off-diagonal pairs. Epoch vol_avg/iomin are scene means; vol_total sums scenes.
code_metrics.denominator: M*M including zeroed diagonal and noncolliding entries; iomin uses half-volume product

code_metrics.definition: perf_counter duration of generate_samples per batch, then mean recorded batch duration; excludes output decode, asset retrieval and rendering. No explicit CUDA synchronization observed around timer.
code_metrics.denominator: Recorded generation calls/batches, not verified end-to-end per-scene latency

papers.name: NaLA: A 3D Native LLM Layout Agent for High-quality 3D Scene Generation
papers.paper_protocol: 60 scenes (20 types x3), about20 objects each. Compared methods receive the same empty room and asset set. NaLA receives native scene/asset point clouds and asset descriptions; this is asset-given, not unknown-size text-inventory generation. Main result is single-pass without post-optimization.

paper_metrics.definition: sum over unordered pairs (Vi+Vj)*indicator[voxel intersection>0] / sum over unordered pairs (Vi+Vj). Binary pair collision weighted by participating volumes, not IoU.
paper_metrics.denominator: Sum pair volume weights; one colliding pair contributes regardless intersection magnitude.

paper_metrics.definition: sum_i Vi*(footprint area outside room / object footprint area) / sum_i Vi.
Exclude wall/ceiling categories; recursively mark floor/contact-supported objects using vertical-distance threshold and horizontal overlap; count unsupported / retained objects.
paper_metrics.denominator: Retained non-wall/ceiling objects; exact numeric threshold not recovered from public scorer.

paper_metrics.definition: Physical/semantic/function-aesthetic Likert1-5 using topdown plus4oblique views; Gemini3.0FlashPreview and20graduate raters; tables use1000bootstrap standard errors.
paper_metrics.denominator: Rating scene/item distributions; judge nondeterminism and scene-level bootstrap must be frozen.

papers.name: SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes
papers.paper_protocol: Open-vocabulary text-to-scene:210 prompts,179room+31house; assets and contextual objects may be added. Different from fixed furniture inventory. Counts/attributes/relations use SceneEval. Baselines get V-HACD128hulls and uniform1000kg/m3; carpets excluded from physics. Human:205completers,3051valid pair judgments, realism and prompt faithfulness; binomial tests with BH-FDR.
papers.paper_metrics_summary: CNT/ATR/OOR/OAR requirement satisfaction; ACC VLM functional sides plus occupancy; NAV largest connected free-floor fraction; OOB objects with<99%surface-point downward rays hitting floor. COL object fraction penetrating>1mm; STB5s gravity,dt1ms, displacement<1cm and rotation<0.1rad, wall/ceiling welded using common VLM support labels. Scene means with95%tCI.

code_metrics.definition: Largest connected walkable pixel component / all walkable pixels (8connectivity); configured floor erosion and object projection.
code_metrics.denominator: All free pixels after preprocessing; not door-seeded reachability

code_metrics.definition: VLM identifies functional sides. Compute free accessible area per side, take per-object maximum side score; scene-summary mean of max>=0 objects. No applicable sides=-1 excluded.
code_metrics.denominator: Objects with applicable functional sides; max over sides rather than all-side mean

code_metrics.definition: Per-object surface sample count=max(OBBvolume*5000,1000); downward floor-ray hit fraction<.99 marks OOB; summary count/N.
code_metrics.denominator: All scene objects; surface samples used within object, not area-weighted aggregate across scene

code_metrics.definition: Count objects participating in object-object penetration beyond1mm; floor penetration separate. SceneAgent implementation uses precomputed SDFs; baselineVHACD excludes carpets internally. Summary divides collision count by num_objects.
code_metrics.denominator: Summary num_objects; must audit common carpet filtering because evaluator internals can exclude carpets while summary uses supplied total

code_metrics.definition: Use support JSON to weld wall/ceiling; ground not welded unless requested. Simulate5s at1ms per config. Stable if finite translation<=.01m and rotation<=.1rad. Aggregates count stable/unstable among non-welded only; welded are listed stable but excluded aggregate. Summary reports unstable/(stable+unstable), so stable score=1-that.
code_metrics.denominator: Non-welded simulated objects only; empty denominator becomes blank in CSV

code_metrics.definition: Inherited SceneEval VLM/annotation metrics; author fork plan runs ObjCountMetric,ObjAttributeMetric,ObjObjRelationshipMetric,ObjArchRelationshipMetric.
code_metrics.denominator: Applicable annotated requirements, not matched GT scene-layout error. Metric implementations not independently reread in this sub-audit; root framework audit supplies detailed definitions.
